summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting its inaugural offering of US$1.0 billion in 4.750% senior notes due 2031. The notes are unsecured and rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt. Proceeds will repay maturing long-term debt, short-term debt, and for general corporate purposes. The offering is expected to close May 26, 2026. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, Mizuho, and RBC. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction by the registrant and does not constitute a special situation. No structural or event-driven considerations are present.
